The RBA’s decision to hit mortgage holders again comes as no surprise after inflation jumped to 4.3% in the year to September, and following tough talk from senior central bank officials over recent days and weeks. items.titleZh: 布洛克称“目前经济尚未崩溃”——事件回顾
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚储备银行今年第五次加息，将现金利率从4.6%上调至4.85%。此举旨在应对中东战争引发的全球石油冲击所导致的通胀压力。
items.whyImportant: 此次加息进一步加重了抵押贷款持有人的财务负担，反映出央行在抑制通胀方面的持续强硬立场。

items.title: Judge pauses Alan Jones indecent assault trial so former broadcaster can watch Melbourne Cup
items.summary: Jones, a former radio broadcaster, has pleaded not guilty to 21 charges of indecent assault and sexual touching Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast The evidence of a star reporter whose investigation led to charges against Alan Jones was paused so the former 2GB broadcaster and horse racing enthusiast could watch the Melbourne Cup. Jones’s defence barrister, Gabrielle Bashir SC, asked judge Glenn Walsh if the court could break just before 3pm to watch the race as Jones sat laughing loudly in the front row of the public gallery. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 法官暂停艾伦·琼斯猥亵案审判，以便这位前广播员观看墨尔本杯赛马
items.summaryZh: 前广播员艾伦·琼斯面临21项猥亵和性接触指控，目前均不认罪。在辩方律师请求下，法官同意暂停庭审，以便琼斯观看墨尔本杯赛马。
items.whyImportant: 此举引发了公众对司法程序严肃性的讨论，尤其是考虑到被告所面临指控的严重性。

items.title: Denmark pushes for EU ban on ‘turbo chickens’ as secret footage causes outrage
items.summary: Minister says government will work towards banning fast-growing breed across country and throughout EU The Danish government is pursuing a national ban on “turbo chickens” and is calling for the fast-growing breed to be prohibited across Europe. The move comes amid widespread outrage over allegations of lawbreaking by one of Denmark’s big chicken producers. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 丹麦推动欧盟禁止“涡轮鸡”，秘密录像引发众怒
items.summaryZh: 丹麦政府正寻求在全国范围内禁止饲养生长过快的“涡轮鸡”，并呼吁欧盟效仿。此前，一家大型鸡肉生产商被曝存在违法行为，引发了广泛的社会愤慨。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了动物福利标准在欧洲农业政策中的重要性日益提升。

items.title: Trump to remove Rwanda and South Africa from US trade deal
items.summary: The move comes barely a week after Rwanda's defence ministry was hit with sanctions by the US Treasury.
items.titleZh: 特朗普将把卢旺达和南非从美国贸易协定中剔除
items.summaryZh: 美国政府决定将卢旺达和南非移出贸易协定。此前一周，卢旺达国防部刚受到美国财政部的制裁。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着美国贸易政策的调整，可能对相关国家的经济关系产生深远影响。

items.title: North Korea denies being behind record $6.3bn Binance hack
items.summary: US government agencies and cyber analysts have blamed Pyongyang for the record-breaking heist.
items.titleZh: 朝鲜否认参与创纪录的63亿美元币安黑客攻击
items.summaryZh: 美国政府机构及网络安全分析师此前指控平壤策划了这起创纪录的加密货币盗窃案。朝鲜方面对此予以否认。
items.whyImportant: 这起案件涉及巨额资金，加剧了国际社会对朝鲜网络犯罪活动的关注与制裁压力。

items.title: RBA interest rates: Bullock says ‘some pain now’ will prevent worse pain later as Reserve Bank hikes rates for fifth time
items.summary: Reserve Bank of Australia increases official cash rate to 4.85%, bringing it to highest level since 2008 RBA interest rates live updates: Reserve Bank cash rate decision Get our daily political email, free app or daily news podcast The Reserve Bank governor Michele Bullock has said that “some pain now will prevent even worse pain down the track,” after lifting official interest rates to an 18-year high of 4.85% in a bid to combat persistent inflation. The RBA’s decision to hit mortgage holders for a fifth time in 2026 will intensify pressure on indebted households, but signals from the central bank suggest policymakers may now wait to gauge the full economic fallout before pulling the trigger again. Sign up for Guardian Australia’s Politics, really newsletter here Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 澳储行利率：布洛克称“现在的一点痛苦”将防止未来更大的痛苦，央行第五次加息
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚储备银行将官方现金利率上调至4.85%，达到2008年以来的最高水平。行长布洛克表示，此举是为了遏制顽固的通胀，尽管这会增加家庭的还贷压力。
items.whyImportant: 利率升至18年高点，将显著影响澳大利亚家庭的消费能力和整体经济增长预期。

items.title: UK ministers told not to engage formally with Indian mega-zoo after lobbying
items.summary: Guardian and Mongabay reveal approaches to officials and MPs on behalf of Vantara zoo ahead of UK-chaired Cites meeting on endangered animal imports British government ministers were told not to engage formally with Vantara, the controversial mega-zoo run by the Indian billionaire Anant Ambani, after lobbying efforts by the private animal sanctuary in the run-up to a UK-chaired meeting on the trade in endangered species, according to documents. This week, the UK heads a 32-country committee meeting in Geneva of Cites, the United Nations body that regulates trade in endangered species. The meeting will examine how India has responded to compliance concerns about imports of endangered animals. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 英国大臣被告知不要与印度大型动物园进行正式接触
items.summaryZh: 文件显示，在联合国濒危物种贸易公约会议前夕，英国大臣们被建议避免与印度亿万富翁安巴尼经营的Vantara动物园进行正式接触。该动物园此前因濒危动物进口合规问题受到质疑。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了英国政府在处理涉及濒危物种贸易的国际外交关系时采取的谨慎态度。

items.titleZh: 布里斯班一对夫妇家中浴室发现孔雀，引发寻找鸟主人的创意行动
items.summaryZh: 一对夫妇回到家时，发现一只孔雀正在浴室镜子前欣赏自己。这只孔雀在被驱逐后依然在逃，目前主人尚未找到。
items.whyImportant: 这起趣闻在当地引发了广泛关注，展示了城市生活中人与野生动物互动的意外一面。

items.title: Shop fridges and freezers across Europe hit by fresh suspected cyber-attack
items.summary: Chains in seven countries say cooling unit temperatures rose overnight in incident similar to hack of French shops Who is hacking Europe’s supermarket fridges and freezers, and why? Supermarket chains in at least seven European countries have said the temperatures of refrigerators and freezers in some of their shops soared overnight to as high as 50C (122F), echoing a cyber-attack last month that caused millions of euros of damage in France. Retailers in Belgium, Estonia, Ireland, Finland, Luxembourg, the Netherlands and Sweden reported problems with their refrigeration systems on Monday, and several companies confirmed they had been hacked. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 欧洲多家超市冷柜疑似遭遇新一轮网络攻击
items.summaryZh: 欧洲七国多家连锁超市报告称，其冷藏设备温度在一夜之间飙升至50摄氏度。此次事件与上个月发生在法国的黑客攻击类似，引发了对食品安全和基础设施脆弱性的担忧。
items.whyImportant: 此类针对零售基础设施的网络攻击可能导致大规模食品损毁并造成严重的经济损失。

items.summary: Nearly 1,600 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza since a US-brokered 'ceasefire' took effect in October last year.
items.titleZh: 以色列军队在加沙打死四人，另有一名巴勒斯坦人伤重不治
items.summaryZh: 自去年10月美国斡旋的“停火协议”生效以来，加沙地带已有近1600名巴勒斯坦人丧生。近期冲突持续，造成人员伤亡不断增加。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了加沙地区停火协议的脆弱性以及持续的人道主义危机。

items.title: 2½ years’ jail for Hong Kong district councillor who had sex with 13-year-old girl in 2011
items.summary: A Hong Kong district councillor has been sentenced to two years and six months in jail for having unlawful sex with a 13-year-old girl 15 years ago, with a judge noting he had shown no remorse towards a victim he claimed to have loved. District Court Judge Stanley Chan Kwong-chi on Tuesday noted that Sei Chun-hing, a 39-year-old Yuen Long District Council member, was aware of the “red line” of sex with a minor when they started dating in October 2010. At the time, she was 13 and Sei 23. Chan...
items.titleZh: 香港一区议员因2011年与13岁少女发生性关系被判入狱两年半
items.summaryZh: 香港一名39岁的区议员因15年前与一名13岁少女发生非法性关系被判刑。法官指出，被告在庭审中对受害者毫无悔意。
items.whyImportant: 此案涉及公职人员的道德操守及对未成年人的法律保护，在社会上引发了广泛关注。

items.title: Xi Jinping meets foreign leaders: tracker, October 2026
items.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping met four foreign leaders in October – two each from Africa and Europe – with the month dominated by the Communist Party Central Committee’s fifth plenum. The pace will probably pick up in November. Xi has already met Oman’s Sultan Haitham bin Tariq, and he will host an Apec summit on November 18–19. The Shenzhen event will probably feature talks with US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin and other regional leaders.
items.titleZh: 习近平会见外国领导人：2026年10月追踪
items.summaryZh: 中国国家主席习近平在10月会见了四位外国领导人，当月工作重点为中共中央五中全会。预计11月外交活动将更加频繁，包括主持APEC峰会并可能与多国领导人举行会谈。
items.whyImportant: 高层外交活动的密集安排反映了中国在国际事务中持续发挥重要影响力。

items.title: Tokenised gold bar to advance Hong Kong’s ambitions as digital, metal trading hub
items.summary: Hong Kong’s plan to start an interbank tokenised gold transaction project marks a crucial step in its quest to make itself a key global hub for the precious metal, according to analysts. The city planned to launch a gold token representing a standard 400-ounce gold bar, referencing HAU, Hong Kong’s ticker for gold prices launched earlier this year, said Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui Ching-yu during the annual Fintech Week event on Monday. He said the effort...
items.titleZh: 代币化金条助力香港打造数字与金属交易中心
items.summaryZh: 香港计划启动银行间代币化黄金交易项目，旨在通过推出代表标准400盎司金条的代币，巩固其作为全球贵金属交易中心的地位。此举是香港金融科技周期间宣布的重要战略举措。
items.whyImportant: 该项目标志着香港在金融资产数字化和提升贵金属市场竞争力方面迈出了关键一步。

items.title: Long delays for Hong Kong court cases demand urgent action
items.summary: Justice delayed, it is often said, is justice denied. If that is true, many court users in Hong Kong are being failed by the system. Those involved in criminal cases at the Court of First Instance must wait 358 days on average for the hearing, the judiciary revealed last week. The figure for the District Court is 354 days, way above the court’s 100-day target. This is a cause of concern. The glacial process has prompted the Law Society to call for drastic measures. Justin Yuen Hoi-ying, chairman...
items.titleZh: 香港法院案件积压严重，亟需采取紧急行动
items.summaryZh: 香港司法机构数据显示，原讼法庭和区域法院的刑事案件平均候审时间远超目标期限。法律界人士呼吁采取果断措施，以解决司法程序缓慢导致的公正受损问题。
items.whyImportant: 司法效率的低下直接影响公众对法治的信心，迫使相关部门寻求改革方案。

items.title: China’s Communist Party plenum targets passive ‘nice’ guys in anti-corruption push
items.summary: China’s ruling Communist Party has pledged to target “old nice persons” within its ranks as it steps up its anti-corruption drive ahead of a major leadership reshuffle next year. Rendered in Chinese as lao hao ren, the term refers to unprincipled, conflict-averse officials who turn a blind eye to misconduct to protect their own careers and social standing. A resolution adopted at the close of the party’s 20th Central Committee’s fifth plenum last week signalled a crackdown on this culture of...
items.titleZh: 中共全会反腐行动瞄准“老好人”文化
items.summaryZh: 中国共产党在二十届五中全会后承诺，将针对党内奉行“老好人”主义的官员进行整治。此举旨在打击那些为了个人仕途而对违纪行为视而不见的无原则官员。
items.whyImportant: 此次反腐重点的调整显示出党内对提升治理效能和强化政治纪律的更高要求。

items.summary: President Donald J. Trump has just completed one of the most relentless, far-reaching travel schedules of any modern presidency: 20 states in 32 days, from Wasilla, Alaska, to Daytona Beach, Florida. At every stop, President Trump took his Administration’s record of results directly to the American people. items.titleZh: 特朗普总统完成历史性巡回访问：32天内走访20个州，举办30场活动
items.summaryZh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普近期完成了现代总统任期内最密集的巡回访问之一。他在32天内走访了20个州，直接向民众宣传其政府的执政成果。
items.whyImportant: 高强度的巡回访问是总统与选民沟通及展示政治议程的重要手段。

items.title: Martha Stewart apologises for homeless person Halloween costume
items.summary: American lifestyle guru Martha Stewart has apologised for an “insensitive and not funny” Halloween costume after she appeared to dress up as a homeless person. “It’s hard to admit when you’ve really screwed up,” the billionaire, 85, wrote on Instagram after she deleted a photo of herself in ripped jeans, a torn jumper and a dirtied face. Stewart also held a clipboard that read “I Am Hungry Help Me!!” Social media users quickly slammed her as out of touch. “I know many people are suffering...
items.titleZh: 玛莎·斯图尔特就其万圣节“流浪汉”装扮道歉
items.summaryZh: 美国生活方式名人玛莎·斯图尔特因其万圣节装扮引发争议而公开道歉。她此前发布了一张身穿破旧衣物、脸部涂脏并手持乞讨标语的照片，随后因被指责脱离群众而将其删除。
items.whyImportant: 此事件反映了公众对于名人利用社会弱势群体形象进行娱乐化表达的敏感度与批评态度。

items.title: US midterm elections: Trump ends campaign, calls Democrats ‘most dangerous ever’
items.summary: US President Donald Trump ended the midterm campaign season on Monday by calling the Democratic Party’s candidates the “most extreme and dangerous” in American history, the day before voters decide which party controls Congress. Speaking at the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool in Washington, which reopened after a renovation by his administration, Trump called the elections “the most important midterm, I believe, in our lifetime”. “These are the most dangerous candidates ever put up,” he...
items.titleZh: 美国中期选举：特朗普结束竞选活动，称民主党人是“史上最危险”
items.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普在选举前夕结束竞选活动，严厉抨击民主党候选人是美国历史上“最极端且危险”的群体。他强调此次中期选举是当代最重要的选举，呼吁选民关注国会控制权。
items.whyImportant: 特朗普的言论进一步加剧了美国政治极化，并为即将到来的国会控制权争夺战定下了激烈的基调。

items.title: Global pedestrian Karl Bushby returns home to UK after 28-year trek
items.summary: Karl Bushby, a British man who traveled 50,000 km without transport over the past 28 years, has come home. Starting in Chile, he crossed the Americas, Russia and parts of Central Asia and Europe — almost all on foot.
items.titleZh: 全球徒步旅行者卡尔·布什比结束28年旅程返回英国
items.summaryZh: 英国男子卡尔·布什比在过去28年里完成了5万公里的徒步旅行，现已平安返回英国。他从智利出发，几乎全程步行穿越了美洲、俄罗斯以及中亚和欧洲的部分地区。
items.whyImportant: 这一壮举展现了人类探索极限的毅力，并引起了全球对长途徒步与地理探索的关注。

items.title: President Trump’s Second Term: Promises Made, Promises Kept, Results Delivered
items.summary: President Donald J. Trump has executed the most sweeping restoration of American sovereignty, strength, and prosperity in modern history. items.titleZh: 特朗普总统的第二任期：承诺已兑现，成果已交付
items.summaryZh: 白宫发布声明称，特朗普总统在第二任期内实现了美国主权、实力与繁荣的全面恢复。声明列举了其在扭转国家衰退及为工薪家庭谋福利方面所取得的各项成就。
items.whyImportant: 该声明作为官方叙事，旨在巩固特朗普的政治遗产并向公众展示其执政成果。

items.title: Israeli forces arrest Al Jazeera journalist in occupied West Bank raid
items.summary: Video of the arrest shows Israeli forces leading Montaser Nassar, who was blindfolded and handcuffed, into a vehicle.
items.titleZh: 以色列军队在约旦河西岸突袭中逮捕半岛电视台记者
items.summaryZh: 视频显示，以色列军队在约旦河西岸的突袭行动中逮捕了半岛电视台记者蒙塔瑟·纳萨尔。被捕时，该记者被蒙住双眼并戴上手铐带上车辆。
items.whyImportant: 此事件引发了关于新闻自由及冲突地区媒体从业者安全保障的广泛讨论。

items.title: US strikes Iran ahead of midterm elections
items.summary: US officials described the attacks on Qeshm Island as limited and defensive, according to CBS, the BBC's US partner.
items.titleZh: 美国在中期选举前夕对伊朗发动袭击
items.summaryZh: 据美国官员称，美军对格什姆岛发动了有限的防御性袭击。此次军事行动发生在美国中期选举前夕。
items.whyImportant: 在中期选举前夕采取军事行动可能对国内选情及中东地缘政治局势产生复杂影响。

items.title: Man and boy arrested after allegedly attacking One Nation volunteer with bat
items.summary: The incident comes amid growing calls for the temperature of political debate in Australia to be turned down.

items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚发生一起针对“单一民族党”志愿者的暴力袭击事件，目前一名男子和一名男孩已被捕。该事件发生之际，社会各界正呼吁降低政治辩论的激烈程度。
items.whyImportant: 此暴力事件凸显了澳大利亚当前政治氛围的紧张，并引发了对政治暴力及社会分裂的担忧。
